title: 10 Best Capparis Spinosa Preparations
intro: The best medicinal preparations of Capparis spinosa are teas, decoctions, tinctures, mucillages, and creams, each offering unique therapeutic benefits. Teas made from the dried leaves and flowers are commonly used to soothe digestive issues and reduce inflammation. Decoctions, which involve boiling the roots, are valued for their potent antimicrobial properties. Mucillages, derived from the plant’s pulp, are used as natural demulcents to ease throat and stomach irritation. Creams infused with Capparis spinosa extracts are applied topically to treat skin conditions and promote healing.
